[EN] Breaking Barabok

[EN] Imagine the giants coming back. I'd rather not.

[EN] The emperor will crush you all!

[EN] Slay Barabok and end the giants' plans for glory.
[ES] Mata a Barabok y arruina los planes de gloria de los gigantes.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Honored to serve."
[ES] "Honrado de servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to Lucael.
